messages:
sre-oncall: FYI eu2 dedicated pool-7 is hitting sustained GPU queue depth and pod wait times. dashboard shows 95% GPU util and queue depth spiking for 4m. evictions just started.
ops-bot: Alert: dedicated-pool-7 queue_depth > 200 (5m avg). Autoscaler: unable to provision pending GPUs due to quota in eu2.
raj: Copy. Is this pure capacity or networking to the pool? any recent deploys?
maria: No deploys in the last hour. Network looks fine from k8s health checks, but kubelet logs show image pull delays on a subset of nodes. not sure it's related.
jenna: Can we steer low-priority orgs to hosted for now? That should relieve the queue.
leo: We have two knobs: 1) temporarily adjust routing weights for dedicated->hosted for low-priority orgs, 2) drop batch sizes for waiting requests. prefer 1 for speed.
raj: Agreed. tagging @maria to run the weight change and @deploy-bot to warm hosted pool. Share exact commands.
maria: Running route change: `rbctl route update --region eu2 --priority low --to-hosted 1.0 --dry-run=false` initiating now.
deploy-bot: warming hosted capacity: spin-up template hosted-eu2-small x10. ETA 45s.
ops-bot: Started weight change. Estimated impact: ~28% of low-priority traffic will move to hosted.
sre-oncall: Good. Monitor latency and token cost for those routes. alert if p95 latency for low-priority > 2.5s.
leo: Also lowering default batch size on dedicated pool for the next 15m: `rbctl config update pool-7 --batch-size 8` to reduce queue length.
jenna: Noting cost: hosted shift will increase per-token cost ~1.8x while active. We should keep it minimal.
raj: Maria, once hosted warm, can we do a gradual 10% step every 30s until queue < 50?
maria: Affirmative. Starting gradual steps. Current queue 230 -> 200 after first step.
sre-oncall: Check autoscaler events and cloud quotas. If provisioning blocked by quota, we'll need to request emergency quota or keep shift.
maria: Quota error in cluster events: "insufficient GPUs in eu2". I submitted quota ticket earlier but not approved yet.
leo: OK hold, continue steps until queue < 60. Also enable kv-prefix cache on heavy call paths to reduce token churn: `feature-flag cache-prefix true` for impacted route.
jenna: Cache change applied for low-priority route. expecting token savings.
ops-bot: Hosted pool warm: nodes ready 10/10. traffic weight now 70% low-priority hosted after step 4.
sre-oncall: Queue trending down: 230 -> 48 over 9m. Evictions stopped. Nice work.
raj: Can we start shifting 5% of medium-priority orgs to hosted for safety? get agreement.
maria: I'd prefer hold on med-priority until we confirm sustained recovery for 10m.
leo: Agree with maria. Also we should document this as a runbook tweak: add a quick-swap command and cost estimate.
jenna: Filing a short incident note and tagging finance for cost delta.
deploy-bot: Rollback knobs scheduled to auto-revert in 30m unless manual confirmation.
sre-oncall: OK keeping monitoring. If queue stays < 60 for 20m we'll start backfill to dedicated with 10% steps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
